column1: # What a person can change of how every app on appkit appears, in the
# profile's Appearance, over the look they chose: the group, the kind
# and the tokens it sets (apart by spaces), the value, and the word of
# the app's text that names it (`prefer.<group>` names the group). The
# first value of a group is what it is when nothing was chosen.
# Which way the light of a ground runs (degrees: 0 is up, 90 to the
# right, 180 down, 270 to the left). The content's grounds run side to
# side only, so up and down turn the window's own panes and leave the
# How strong a ground's light is at rest, as a share of the strongest.
# How far across the light reaches before it is gone.
# The light's own colour: any from the wheel.
